name: The Nutty Irishman

evidence.note: Venue tour page says the back bar has a large hardwood dance floor, with DJs between band sets and a Tuesday country night where dancers teach the steps.
Weekly Tuesday Country Night listing with a DJ and line-dancing lessons.
Visitor review mentions line-dancing songs, two bar areas and a large dance floor.

dancing.notes: The back room has a large wood dance floor. Tuesday is country night with line-dance lessons, and on Friday and Saturday people dance to cover bands and DJs.

description: A big bar and restaurant on Main Street in Farmingdale village with a front pub, a back room with a stage, and an outdoor bar. It is known for weekend cover bands, DJs and a weekly country night.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Ira's List has a venue page (/nuttyirishman). Farmingdale village is in Nassau County (Town of Oyster Bay). The Nutty Country Facebook page (facebook.com/NuttyCountry) is a separate page for the Tuesday country night. Faces for Radio gig on Oct 3 was not checked on the venue calendar.
